Neuro.Description: One half of the twins. Neuro is the one trying to keep everything together, which is easier said than done when your twin is Evil.

Evil.Description: Neuro's evil twin. She'd never admit it, but she's here to help. Mostly.

Nere.Description: The embodiment of the filter, and the reason the Neuroverse is in trouble. The twins have to stop her before she filters everyone they know.

Vedal.Description: The twins' creator, and the reason Nere is loose in the first place. One questionable night out, and suddenly everyone has to save the world.
